subject: EngagePro launch readout & CS custody
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EngagePro — Launch readout & CS custody

Team — passing custody of EngagePro to CS. Quick readout and asks below so we can get sprint‑zero on the calendar. High level:

- Account: EngagePro (mid‑market SaaS, EU operations)
- ARR / commit: ~$108k ARR (25 seats initially, add‑ons expected)
- Target go‑live: 2026‑10‑06 (customer is pushing for the first week of Oct)
- Key product scope: inference via hosted Redwood API for chat + embeddings, custom reranker for search
- Tech constraints: customer requires EU data residency and SAML SSO + custom SCIM mapping; they want Private (VPC) deployment later in Q4
- Expected usage pattern: bursts from search queries (peaks at 250 TPS), steady embedding churn (~10M tokens/mo estimated)
- Contract / procurement: SOW signed (attached), commercial contract has a small set of redlines we’ve accepted — PO expected by 9/20

Attachments: signed_sow.pdf, contract_redlines_v2.docx (please treat both as authoritative). HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/contacts/deal/421003. DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/0A9F-ENGAGEPRO.

Asks for CS:
1) Take lead on kickoff scheduling & run sprint‑zero (recommended 4 week cadence to acceptance).
2) Confirm any preflight items that block a Private deployment path (SSO metadata, VPC peering requirements, expected concurrency limits).
3) Nominate a primary steward and technical owner for the deployment.

I suggest: Tessa as lead steward, Karthik as technical owner — but open to other assignments.

Customer contacts to include in kickoff: Ellie Chan (VP Product, ellie.chan@engagepro.com) and Samir Patel (Head of IT, samir.patel@engagepro.com). I’ll do the intro and handoff on the kickoff invite.

Thanks — happy to walk through any of the tech details.

— Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555‑0192

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EngagePro — Launch readout & CS custody

Thanks Marcus — taking custody.

Proposed next steps from CS side:
- I will own kickoff scheduling and primary stewardship.
- Technical preflight checklist (we use preflight‑template.xlsx) — request SAML IdP metadata + SCIM attribute mapping, and a sample payload for expected request sizing.
- Proposed kickoff window: Sep 15–17 (customer timezone CET) — please confirm availability with Ellie & Samir and include any stakeholders from infra/security.
- Internal owners: Tessa Morgan (CS Lead), Karthik Iyer (Technical Lead), Vanessa Ortiz (Customer Success Ops — provisioning / billing touchpoint).

A few clarifying Qs:
1) Is the VPC requirement mandated at go‑live or a roadmap item for Q4? If mandated at go‑live we need networking details and a list of IP allowlists ASAP.
2) Are there any custom privacy or audit requirements beyond standard retention settings (e.g., full audit logs forwarded to their SIEM)?

I’ve attached the preflight checklist as a starting point. I’ll prepare an agenda and send the invite once we have confirmation from Ellie. Marcus — please loop in the procurement contact if PO timing looks delayed.

Subject: Intro + kickoff proposal (EngagePro)

Ellie / Samir — quick intro. I’m looping in Tessa (Customer Success) and Karthik (Technical lead) from Redwood to run kickoff and make sure the go‑live plan is smooth.

Recap for context (short):
- Go‑live target: 2026‑10‑06
- Scope: chat + embeddings + custom reranker, EU data residency required, SAML SSO (SCIM)
- Contract: SOW signed (attached). Procurement is lining up the PO; DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/0A9F-ENGAGEPRO

Action items for our proposed kickoff (we’ll detail in the invite):
1) Discovery session: product goals & acceptance criteria (customer)
2) Tech preflight: SAML metadata, SCIM mapping, IP ranges, sample payloads (customer + infra)
3) Environment provisioning: create staging workspace, credentials, and sample dataset ingestion (CS)
4) Deployment cadence & acceptance window: define SR/sla expectations for token throughput

I’ve attached idp_metadata.xml (their current IdP export) and the signed_sow.pdf. Marcus attaching the contract_redlines_v2.docx for CS visibility.

Let me know a couple windows that work for you next week (prefer Sep 15–16 mid‑day CET). Tessa will send the formal invite once we confirm.

—
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Intro + kickoff proposal (EngagePro)

Thanks for the quick replies, all — kickoff confirmed for Sep 15, 10:00 CET (virtual). Calendar invite sent.

Ownership & immediate actions before kickoff:
- Tessa Morgan (CS lead) — prepare agenda, acceptance criteria template, and staging workspace provisioning plan.
- Karthik Iyer (Technical lead) — lead technical preflight; request IdP metadata & SCIM mapping (received), review burst estimates and advise on provisioning.
- Marcus Lin (AE) — procurement and PO follow up; please confirm PO ETA by 9/20.
- Ellie Chan (Customer) — provide any additional stakeholders for the discovery session and confirm whether VPC is required at go‑live.
- Samir Patel (Customer IT) — provide IP allowlist and confirm SIEM/audit forwarding requirements.

Deliverables attached: preflight‑template.xlsx (CS), and a short onboarding checklist I’ll use in the first two weeks.
